decisions.reason: As the flagship biodynamic yogurt aligned with the firm's organic core and still marketed after two years, its option value is high and uncertainty remains manageable, so it should be kept.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page, the mild sliced cheese is still an option with unresolved prospects and low marginal cost to maintain, so it is kept while results accumulate.
Like the mild sliced cheese, sliced butter cheese is a newly launched option with high uncertainty and low continuation cost, so it is kept to learn about its value.
